programme.desc: Though excited to learn that she will be working on Christmas Day, Fran is surprised to hear that Maxwell will be producing a benefit in Washington D.C. Told that the Sheffields will celebrate Christmas one day early, Fran is further disappointed to find that Maxwell farms out all of his gift buying to a personal shopper. So, upon finding that the children don't believe in Santa and that what Grace really wants is to have her father home on Christmas, Fran decides to have a talk with Maxwell -- until Niles points out that he is preparing the staff s Christmas bonuses. Revealing that C.C. will also be joining him in Washington but insisting that their trip will be all business, Maxwell is nonetheless persuaded to do his own shopping for a change. So, when Fran relies on Niles' assessment of her bonus and buys the children some expensive gifts, she discovers that, instead of money, Maxwell bought her a beautiful vase. Faced with having to either take back her gifts or somehow pay the bill, Fran declines Niles' offer of a loan and goes to see Val's Uncle Paulie to pawn the vase. But, when Maxwell mentions it later, Fran guiltily rushes to buy it back and, forced to pay twice what she got, sells her grandmother's watch instead. Receiving a call from Niles with word about Fran and the watch, Maxwell decides to make things right. So, leaving C.C. behind at the airport, he intercepts the family at St. Patrick's Cathedral and finds Fran in a confessional seeking help with her financial difficulties. Finally, after returning the watch and then accidentally sitting on the vase, Maxwell ends up at the hospital being treated for his wounds, while Grace gets her wish and renews her belief in Santa Claus.

programme.title: The Rapping Politician & The 90's Rap Icon
programme.desc: Matchmaker Patti Stanger takes on the most challenging clients of her lifetime and this week is no exception. Former politician and current rapper Shawn Isaac aka “Shawn Don” checks in with an unrealistic wish list based on credentials rather than chemistry. He hasn’t dated seriously in four years and dumped his only girlfriend because she didn’t meet his “resume requirements”. Patti gives Shawn a much-needed love lesson and discovers some shocking information that helps explain Shawn’s logistical rather than emotional mindset when it comes to love. But Shawn has a huge secret that could change everything… Meanwhile, 90’s Grammy nominated music icon, Monie Love, has to control everything in her universe. At 46 years old, she’s feeling the pressure to find Mr. Right and settle down but her micromanaging habits are blocking any chance she has at finding love. Patti discovers Monie’s controlling ways stem from her childhood and that deep-rooted behavior brings out the worst in the men she dates. Patti’s mission is to transform Monie from an overbearing alpha into a softer, gentler beta, but that winds up being much harder than expected. Will either Shawn or Monie take Patti’s advice and find love or will they break her rules and check out of the Millionaire’s Club alone?

programme.title: Varneka Edwards
programme.desc: Living in Bear, Delaware is nothing like living in New York City. Varneka Edwards is trying to bring the Big Apple to her town on her wedding day.

programme.title: Great Gatsby Bride
programme.desc: David Tutera meets a bride who wants a peacock feather, 1920’s inspired wedding, and yet she doesn’t have reception space three weeks away from the big day! Kimberly Marrero has style and grace and a beautiful wedding gown. Her bridesmaids dresses don’t fit David’s vision of an elegant big day, so they are the first to change. And why the change? David wants to give Kimberly a Great Gatsby inspired wedding and where better to celebrate but Oheka Castle? And while our bride looks divine in her wedding dress, David surprises her with a reception dress perfect to dance away the night! Vintage accessories will be the finishing touches that make this bride look like she stepped out of a story book from the 1920’s.

programme.title: Springtime and Flowers Bride
programme.desc: Every bride has her wedding lists, but David Tutera is about to meet a controlling bride who has lists for her lists and more lists. Jaymie Wildin wants a springtime wedding, but her log cabin venue makes it feel more like a ski trip getaway! And will she let David change the wedding gown she’s determined to keep? A “fashion crime” is how David describes the bridesmaids dresses, so they have to go. Jamie’s two main wishes for her wedding are fresh flowers and a fabulous cake, so making his brides dreams come true, David has Jamie pick out her favorite perennials, followed by a trip to a cake designer that brings a huge smile to her face! And the surprises don’t stop there! David lets her know that she will be getting married in a beautiful venue full of whimsical wonderment fit for a springtime bride.

programme.title: Poker Bride
programme.desc: Lucky in love is a great saying for a wedding, but when you add poker chips, LED dice on a garter, and red and black feathers, you’ll be lucky if you know where you are! David Tutera meets Nicole Goodman and finds out that her wedding is all over the place. Her wedding gown makes her look like a lounge singer and his first change is to have her try three styles of his bridal gown designs. Then the bridesmaids have to be dressed to the nines to shine at the wedding. Then David has a first for the show with the groom to be getting a custom tailored tuxedo. And while the bride and groom are together with David, they learn that their venue is being changed to the Prince George Ballroom. The surprises continue as Nicole’s wedding day has a special guest flown in and the happy couple get a honeymoon fit for two people “lucky in love”!

programme.title: Zen Bride
programme.desc: Planning a wedding usually involves some chaos, even for David Tutera. But he’s about to meet a bride whose zen themed wedding has her so calm, David’s not sure why he’s there. First of all, her décor is beautiful, bridesmaid’s dresses are lovely and her wedding gown is absolutely perfect for her ceremony. So why is he there? David meets the brides Mother who is a big part of Jessica’s wedding. And even Mom, a big part of the wedding, is good to go. Jessica and David go to her reception venue, and it’s better suited for a rehearsal dinner than a wedding, and there’s NO dance floor! Where will the bride and groom have their first dance? So now David knows what he needs to do. First thing, a gorgeous gown for the mother of the bride, followed by a one-of-a-kind, AMAZING, party dress. How about a change of venue to a chic loft space fit with a water filled dance floor? And the surprises don’t end there. Jessica and her fiancé XX get dance lessons from a celebrity dance instructor and then a first for David and his bride, trapeze lessons to let her “let loose” of all her wedding stress! When the big day comes, our zen bride experiences a magical big day filled with water, fire, light and love.

programme.title: The Wedding Place

programme.title: Married by the In-Laws
programme.desc: Four parents, two families, one wedding. In this new reality show, “Married by the In-Laws,” the parents of one couple take charge of planning the wedding.

programme.title: The Wedding Planners
programme.desc: Weddings come in all shapes and sizes, with differing personal tastes, cultural elements, and, of course, budgetary constraints. And so do wedding planners.

programme.title: This Old Spouse
programme.desc: THIS OLD SPOUSE is a heartwarming reality TV show that focuses on couples who have lost some of the spark in their relationship.

programme.title: Bad Boy Magnet and The Insta-Ham
programme.desc: This week at the Millionaire’s Club, matchmaker Patti Stanger faces off against Tiffany Foxx, a sexy rap artist and star of “Love and Hip Hop.” Tiffany has a type…bad boys, and her 14-year long relationship was with a man who spent 9 of those years in prison! As predicted, Tiffany fails her love lesson and Patti begins to realize that the problem goes deeper, into childhood. An emotional Tiffany finally recognizes she needs to change. But when Patti throws a test into her mingle, will Tiffany revert to type or reach for true love with a good guy? At the same time, Patti and her team take on Christopher Lourdes, who spends his days posting on Instagram. He uses the social media site to flash his wealth and meet women who are only after one thing…his wallet. Patti needs to put the brakes on his social media frenzy and show him that he’s only attracting “Instawhores.” A resistant Christopher finally agrees to try things Patti’s way but backslides horribly endangering his possibilities to check out with his date. Both Patti’s clients this week need to choose their paths wisely. If they don’t, Tiffany and Christopher will leave the club alone.

programme.title: Mr. Hit It And Quit It and The Baywatch Babe
programme.desc: If you think Patti Stanger has faced her toughest clients, you ain’t seen nothing yet. When Candace brings in her good friend Marcellas Reynolds, a gay celebrity stylist with a bigger than life personality, Patti certainly has her hands full. Marcellas likes to “hit it and quit it” and never gets beyond surface looks with his partners. But when he miserably fails his love lesson, Patti makes him face his behavior resulting in an explosive moment you’d never expect. Realizing there’s more going on than meets the eye, Patti tells Marcellas that he needs to go deeper and be vulnerable with others if he wants a chance at true love. At the same time, Donna D’Errico, a Baywatch babe formerly married to Nikki Sixx from Motley Crue, is back on the dating scene for the first time since her difficult divorce. Soon to be an empty nester, Donna needs Patti’s guidance to have fun again and stop assuming men will disappoint her. Both Patti’s clients have built walls to protect themselves and she and her team have to go into ninja matchmaker mode to break them down. And if Marcellas and Donna don’t follow Patti’s rules and open themselves to the possibilities out there, they’ll go home alone.

programme.title: Crazy Kelly & The Desperate Housewife
programme.desc: 3rd Generation matchmaker Patti Stanger is back and better than ever. She’s taken over an exclusive boutique hotel where she takes on the toughest cases she’s ever seen. This week, Patti has two Real Housewives check in: Liar Magnet Claudia Jordan from Atlanta and “Crazy” Kelly Bensimon from New York. Patti helps Kelly get over her nasty reality TV reputation and see that her insecurity is all in her head. Claudia goes deep with Patti, and exposes her traumatic experiences with men that lead her to attract all the wrong men. Patti goes to extreme measures to get Claudia to thoroughly vet guys to find her Mr. Right. It’s time to call the man who Claudia needs to confront in order to move on and find true love. Patti and her team gather the best of the best for a sexy all-male mingle where the housewives get their pick of the litter. The Housewives choose their dates, but will Claudia vet her date enough (or too much) and will Kelly keep the “crazy” away? At the end of the week, will these Housewives take their lessons to heart and go home crazy in love or will they check out alone?

programme.title: Mr. Self-Absorbed & The Trainwreck
programme.desc: Patti Stanger has never met clients who challenge her as much as the two this week. TV star Courtney Stodden is only 22 years-old but she’s been in the media eye since she was 16, when she controversially married a 50-year-old actor. Now single, Courtney is making up for lost time by partying like a rockstar! Is Courtney straight, bi-sexual or gay, she’s not sure so Patti preps for her first ever bi-sexual mingle. What we do know is that Courtney hates rules, she hates being told what to do and she hates keeping her clothes on. Patti is tasked with trying to tame this wild child who is mentally a rebellious 16-year-old, but to do so Patti is forced to use extreme measures. Meanwhile, MMA fighter Shondo Blades checks in with a huge chip on his shoulder and a strong need to be the center of attention. His excuse for having three kids with two women and never married is that women can’t keep up with him. But during the love lesson, Patti checks him by pointing out he’s a self-absorbed one man show that leaves no room for a co-star. And to add insult to injury, a commitment phoebe. Pissed at the truth, Shondo threatens to leave the Millionaire’s Club and tensions explode. Can Patti find a way to break through to her combative clients or will their extreme behaviors sabotage their search for love?

programme.title: MARIA & CHRIS
programme.desc: Maria and Chris celebrate their nuptials with multiple events at the highly secluded and private South Seas Island Resort off the coast of Florida. Pre-ceremony events include a golf tournament for their guests, afternoon spa treatments, and an exotic Caribbean themed welcome party. The wedding itself is Chic Island Elegance, with green and white d�cor and amber lighting. Orchid chandeliers, glittering carved ice elements, and a Miami club themed after party captivate their guests.

programme.title: CHRISTINE & JONATHAN
programme.desc: All brides should be as fortunate as Christine. When she can't find the perfect chapel for her wedding to Jonathan, her father builds her one! And he doesn't stop there. He creates an entire $4 million wedding village, including a high-tech reception ballroom, a perfect courtyard for cocktail hour, luxe suites for the bridal party, and even a jewelry store and a spa for pre-wedding pampering. For Christine's special day, she and her designer fill the ballroom and chapel with a romantic secret garden look, highlighted by manzanita wood centerpieces dripping with hydrangeas and orchids. The evening is rounded out with gourmet dinner stations and a whimsical “Mad hatter” style wedding cake.

programme.title: ANISHA & KENNARD
programme.desc: When the daughter of baseball Hall of Famer Tony Gwynn marries a young ball player, the celebration is bound to be a home run! The bride proudly ties all aspects of her wedding to the family's love of the game. In a nod to the baseball diamond, she exclusively wears diamond jewelry – $1.35 million worth! Throughout the ceremony and reception are dozens of dramatic, large, pav� yellow rose balls, evoking the image of baseballs. The cocktail hour noshes are glammed-up ball game food like Kobe beef sliders and petite French fries made with truffle oil. The groom's cake fits the theme to a T, looking so much like an actual baseball glove that it's almost a shame to eat it.

programme.title: NAOMI & GEORGE
programme.desc: The guests of a Black Eyed Peas guitarist and a Hollywood hairstylist are in for an adventure of a lifetime when the couple whisks them away to Mexico. They have several events planned at the lush Xcaret eco park, from a rocking welcome party to swimming with sharks, to the wedding itself. The ceremony has a very Spanish feel in its ancient open-air chapel, complete with bridesmaids in purple charmeuse gowns and red roses in their hair flanking the gorgeous bride with a custom peineta holding her veil in place. It's followed by an incredible reception in a cave that's vibrantly decked out in reds and purples.

programme.title: NATALIE & BOB
programme.desc: A library has never looked as breathtaking as Sacramento's Tsakopoulos Library looks decked out in Natalie and Bob's wedding d�cor. The soaring space is draped in 48-yard-long panels of red fabric, and underneath are exquisite tablescapes of silver-edged place settings and centerpieces created from 20 types of red flowers. This fun-loving couple makes the most of their preparations, with a gourmet food tasting to narrow down their menu, and a decadent wine and chocolate tasting party with their friends. The bride makes a foray into an exclusive jewelry store that results in $1 million of wedding day glam.

programme.title: CRISTINA & JORGE
programme.desc: Two elements characterize the wedding of Cristina and Jorge: their Cuban heritage and perfectly executed pops of color. It's important to the couple that the food is incredible, and since they're in South Beach, Florida, their chef incorporates Cuban spices and fruits into a steak and lobster dinner to create a modern “Floribbean” feast. The d�cor has an elegant, clean look with a lot of black and white, while drama comes from fuchsia accents. Crystal-filled vases are topped with a stunning cube-shaped design of 600 bright pink double dianthus flowers per centerpiece. And the wedding cake is one-of-a-kind: layers of cake draped in black fondant fronted with fuchsia and white rectangles alternate with layers of acrylic boxes filled with crystals!

programme.title: Swamp Bride
programme.desc: What is David Tutera to do with a bride who is allergic to flowers and wants her wedding décor to resemble a swamp? This is a first for David, and with only three weeks until the wedding, he’s going to either sink or swim. His first challenge is to get his head strong bride to agree to change out her wedding gown. Not easy. And as for the bridesmaid’s dresses that look like lily pads? Oh yes, they are second to go! Since David’s bride has such a unique vision for her big day, he’s on a quest for one-of-a-kind wedding favors. Favors that have to include frogs – yes, frogs. And finally, it’s time to face the challenge of what food to serve at this wedding, so what better than a yummy food tasting. And when the big day finally arrives, our bride has all of Manhattan as a backdrop and fireworks to finalize a magical day.

programme.title: Diva Bride
programme.desc: They say everything is bigger in Texas, and so is the personality of David Tutera’s new Dallas bride. When she says “diva”, you better say ‘licious” , because she’s a force to be reckoned with. How do you combine Lady Gaga, Beyonce, Mardi Gras and pink feathers into a wedding? With three weeks until the big day, David decides to make everything off the charts! Glittery, glamorous reception dresses for not only the bride but the bridesmaids as well. And nothing says “diva” like an over-the-top photo shoot! And what better location for this production, than a theater complete with a red carpet entrance!

programme.title: Cowgirl Bride
programme.desc: With many brides, the dress is the most important thing for her wedding. But with David Tutera’s next bride – it’s all about the cowboy boots! This Texas cowgirl is dead set on two stepping her way into the sunset, and David is determined to have her step into a pair of nice heels! The challenges start with giving the bride a sophisticated gown to wear – with or without boots! And speaking of boots, how about bridal boot camp to get into shape for the big day? A picture-perfect Texas ranch transforms into the ideal setting for our country bride to dance the night away under the stars.

programme.title: Pirate Bride
programme.desc: David Tutera has planned plenty of destination weddings, so when he heard about a Caribbean wedding, the last thing he thought it would be was, “pirates of the Caribbean”! David’s latest bride, Brooke Lewis loves the idea of pirates, but instead of planning an elegant wedding, it’s turning into a 5-year-olds birthday party! So her décor and venue are the first to go when David takes over the planning. Brooke gets a beautiful and romantic wedding gown, and the bridesmaids are decked out in jewel-toned dresses. And since this bride is a true treasure, she needs to wear stunning jewels – how about $250,000 worth? And just when she thinks the surprises are done, David takes her on a little climbing expedition. Something that will make her trust her wedding planner as well as letting off a little steam.

programme.title: Butterfly Bride
programme.desc: Where does David Tutera begin with a bride who wants butterflies, rainbows, butterflies and then more butterflies? Monique Villegas is a sweet bride who loves colors and whimsy but has no idea how to pull off a wedding. With only 3 weeks before her big day, David takes charge, and the magic begins. Rainbows are captured in the Swarovski crystal jewelry that our bride tries on. And how about a champagne toast at sunset in a private jet, flying high above Los Angeles to make a brides dreams come true?

His clever ploys, however, lead to an unexpected result.

programme.title: The House Bunny
programme.desc: The story of a Playboy Bunny who teaches an awkward sorority about the opposite sex - only to learn that what boys really like is what's on the inside.

programme.title: Adventures of a Taxi Driver
programme.desc: Joe likes the ladies and gets to meet a variety of them in his job as a taxi driver. From dizzy young women to frustrated housewives, Joe fancies them all, and they take a fancy to Joe. If only things were smoother at home for the put-upon cabbie. With his nagging mother, thieving teenage brother, and the attentions of an overbearing girlfriend with ideas of marriage, Joe leaves the homestead and rents the spare room at his best mate's flat. Meanwhile, he continues to find himself in an assortment of humorous sexual escapades until he accidentally becomes embroiled in a jewel heist that doesn't quite go to plan.

programme.title: Queen of the Desert
programme.desc: A chronicle of Gertrude Bell's life, a traveler, writer, archaeologist, explorer, cartographer, and political attach for the British Empire at the dawn of the twentieth century.

programme.title: The Monster
programme.desc: A mother and daughter must confront a terrifying monster when they break down on a deserted road.

programme.title: The Hitman's Apprentice
programme.desc: When 19-year-old Adam agrees to do a day's driving for his mum's gangster boyfriend Peter, it takes him on a 24-hour journey into a nightmarish world of murder, sex trafficking and revenge, in the company of aging hit man Roy.

programme.title: Love N' Dancing
programme.desc: Jessica (Amy Smart) had given up on her dream of a life of the stage, until she meets ex-dance champion Jake (Tom Malloy), who becomes her teacher when the couple make an instant connection. Together, they decide to risk it all when they enter the World Swing Championship to reclaim Jake's former title.

programme.title: Adventures of a Plumber's Mate
programme.desc: Times are hard for plumber Sid South. Up to his neck in bills, facing eviction from his home and in debt to a violent bookie, he desperately needs to raise some funds or else Sid will be a broken man - literally, as there are two thugs ready to break every bone in his body unless he hands over the cash he owes their boss. It doesn't help that Sid never seems to get paid for any of the work he does, as his occupation lands him in a variety of risqu situations which always end in disaster. Drastic times call for drastic measures, and the browbeaten plumber seeks employment from Dodger, a shady wheeler-dealer who can put some dubious work Sid's way. But, as always, things never seem to go exactly to plan and the beguiled plumber finds himself in further strife.

programme.title: Me, Myself and Di
programme.desc: After winning the 'trip of a lifetime' to a caravan park in Rhyl, North Wales, unlucky in love Northerner, Janet Brown, is ready for a holiday romance. Unfortunately, following the advice of best friend Diana (Lucy Pinder) - that Janet should pretend to be the opposite of who she actually is in order to find love - doesn't quite lead to the happily ever after she was hoping for. A laugh-out-loud gritty rom-com with a huge ensemble cast including James Lance (Northern Soul, Bronson, Marie Antoinette, Bel Ami), Will Mellor (Two Pints of Lager and a Packet of Crisps, Line of Duty), Larry Lamb (EastEnders, The Hatton Garden Job), Marek Oravec (Captain America: The First Avenger), Wim Snape (The Full Monty, Coronation Street), and Katy Clayton (Casualty, Shameless).

programme.title: Gladiatress
programme.desc: 55BC Somewhere In Britain: The Princesses of the Dubonni tribe are three unlikely sisters: Smirgut The Fierce (Fiona Allen), ferocious warrior and full-time mum, Dwyfuc (Doon Mackichan), desperate spinster in search of a hairy husband and Worthaboutapig (Sally Phillips), clumsy village bee-herder. Roman soldiers kidnap Dwyfuc, detaining her in Boulogne. Seduced by Roman society, she reveals locations of British ports crucial to the Romanss invasion strategy. Smirgut and Worthaboutapig set out on a perilous rescue mission together they must prevent the downfall of Celtic Britain, encountering gods, lawyers, soothsayers, barbarians and the Otherworld. Girl power is alive and kicking and ready to take on the Romans

programme.title: Pandorum
programme.desc: Two astronauts (Dennis Quaid, Vantage Point and Ben Foster, 30 Days of Night) awaken in a hyper-sleep chamber aboard a seemingly abandoned spacecraft. It's pitch black, they are disoriented, and the only sound is a low rumble and creak from the belly of the ship. They can't remember anything like who they are and what their mission is, but one thing they do realise very quickly is that they are not alone. Slowly the spacecraft's shocking, deadly secrets are revealed and the astronauts find that they must fight to stay alive and that their survival is more important than they could ever have imagined. Directed by Christian Alvart and also starring Cam Gigandet (Twilight), Cung Le (Tekken) and newcomer Antje Traue.

programme.title: Lady Bloodfight
programme.desc: Jane is a beautiful but troubled American girl backpacking her way through Hong Kong. When she successfully fends off three thugs trying to rob her, it draws the attention of Shu, a Wudang champion, who is impressed by her raw street fighting abilities. Shu recruits Jane and trains her to fight in the vicious, all-female, underground martial arts tournament known as The Kumite.

programme.title: It's a Boy Girl Thing
programme.desc: It's A Boy Girl Thing is a brilliantly funny romantic comedy about next-door neighbours who live worlds apart. Woody Deane (Zegers) and Nell Bedworth (Armstrong) are life long sworn enemies who wake up one day to find themselves in a very strange place: each others bodies. In their switched identities, each sets out to destroy the other's high school reputation. When they start to succeed they get more than they bargained for. Sometimes falling in love can be an out of body experience.

programme.title: The Way
programme.desc: Martin Sheen plays Tom, an American doctor who comes to France to collect the remains of his adult son who was killed in the Pyrenees in a storm while walking The Camino de Santiago - also known as 'The Way of Saint James'. Driven by his desire to understand his lost son, Tom decides to embark on the historical pilgrimage, leaving his California life behind. Armed only with his son's backpack and guidebook, he begins the 800km historical pilgrimage but soon discovers that he won't be alone on this journey - he meets other pilgrims from around the world, all broken and looking for greater meaning in their lives. From the hardship experienced along "The Way" an unlikely group of misfits are bonded and Tom begins to learn the difference between 'The life we live and the life we choose.'

programme.title: Call of The Wild
programme.desc: Call of The Wild is a modern-day story incorporating elements of Jack London's classic short novel. Whilst Ryann (Ariel Gade) is staying with her Grandpa Bill (Christopher Lloyd) a wild hybrid wolf/dog shows up injured on the back porch one night. Ryann and a local friend believe they can train the magnificent animal to become a sled dog leader but first they must try and persuade Grandpa, who knows the animal will eventually have to return to the wild. Then they must stand up to the local bully who wants to claim the dog as his own.

programme.title: G-Loc
programme.desc: In a world on the brink of environmental collapse, mass migration to neighbouring planet, Rhea, is humanity's final hope for survival. The only problem is, in the sixteen Earth years since the first humans landed on Rhea, two hundred and eighty-eight years have passed on the new planet and the existing population are no longer welcoming new arrivals, with the Rheans having set up a space blockade to shot down any ship that tries to cross into their territory. 'Earther', Bran, has big dreams of a better life in this new world, but the odds are stacked against him. Finding himself the lone survivor of a failed emigration attempt, his escape pod floats mindlessly in space and his oxygen is running low. His only chance of survival is to hook up to a rogue Rhean supply ship called The Nysa running on auxiliary power. But after finding the crew on board The Nysa dead, it seems Bran may have more than just a hostile planet to worry about. An intense interstellar thriller with an impressive cast, including Stephen Moyer (True Blood), Casper Van Dien (Starship Troopers) and John Rhys-Davies (the Indiana Jones and Lord of the Rings franchises).

programme.title: Surviving Love
programme.desc: Jessica Miller is thrust into the "real" world when she graduates from college. To conquer this new world, she must discover her faith, open a box of memories and learn the simple secrets of life only a mother can share.

programme.title: My One True Love
programme.desc: When 2 of the 3 things a fortune teller predicts come true, Ali wonders about the 3rd - finding true love with a man named John. Drawn to a fireman whose name isn't John, does she trust destiny or her heart?

programme.title: Made For You with Love
programme.desc: The owner of used wedding gown business breathes new life into used dresses, making dreams come true for brides unable to afford pricey gowns. But when she meets the perfect guy, she's afraid to give her own heart a second chance at love.

programme.title: Love Finds You in Sugarcreek
programme.desc: A father and son fleeing a shocking and brutal tragedy settle in the predominantly Amish town of Sugarcreek, Ohio. They are taken in by three sisters who offer the father work as a handyman, but a local policewoman begins to become suspicious of his past.

programme.title: Midway to Love
programme.desc: When the network announces that her television therapy show is changing to a tabloid shock-fest, a straight laced and caring psychologist returns to her hometown and reunites with her high school sweetheart while finally realizing that having someone to share a life with is more important than fame and the excitement of the city.

programme.title: All Aboard For Love
programme.desc: As Alison prepares for new ocean adventures, business executive Joel navigates his way into her heart and they become co-captains for life.

programme.title: Ruling of the Heart
programme.desc: Judge Morgan has become known for his no-nonsense toughness in court. He rules fast and he rules hard, barely noticing the person on the other end of his decisions. When he gets stuck in a cafe during a snowstorm, he is surprised to discover two of the other customers stranded with him happen to be people recently in his court, with verdicts handed down that have made him very unpopular. As the night unfolds in the small cafe, unexpected truth emerges from both sides that changes everything.

programme.title: The Beauty of Love
programme.desc: Emma has built a successful lifestyle website that she puts her heart and soul into called "Classically Emma". But when her numbers start trending down, she thinks she might've found her fix in a partnership with ambitious Jill.

programme.title: Romance In The Air
programme.desc: After learning her marketing job is on the line, Eden returns to Lake Tahoe where she used to spend her summers growing up. Intending to relax and recharge so she can tackle her job again, she is surprised to find her childhood friend and sweetheart Riley is still living next door. She finds purpose in helping Riley propel his struggling hot air balloon tour company, and also finds herself drawn to him and their dear past. However, Eden sees Riley and Tahoe as temporary, while her life—and boyfriend—back home await her. She can’t admit that she and Riley could have a future, even if that’s exactly what she wants. When she’s willing to take a risk for what her heart wants, her life will take off with her true love.

There he releases Jeannie, a beautiful blonde, who can perform magic with a blink of her eyes, from a bottle is which she has been imprisoned for ages. Jeannie tells Tony she is his slave forever. Worried about Jeannie's effect on Melissa and his career, Tony tries to leave Jeannie behind on the island, but she smuggles herself aboard the rescue plan. Questioned about his reactions in space by the base psychiatrist, Dr. Alfred Bellows, Tony tells about his meeting with Jeannie. Tony tries frantically to keep General Stone, Melissa, Doctor Bellows and Captain Roger Henley, a fellow astronaut, from seeing Jeannie. His problems reach a climax when Jeannie produces a harem of dancing girls to perform for Tony. After Tony works his way out of that, Melissa and her father leave, feeling a vacation, combined with a honeymoon, will solve Tony's problems. programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)
programme.desc: Walter and Margaret Brocken ask Samantha to keep their son Merle, a ten year old warlock, while they attend a witches convention. When Merle agrees not to do any magic before Darrin, Samantha invites him to stay. Meanwhile, Larry Tate asks Darrin to keep an expensive necklace, a birthday present for. his wife, at the Stephens home. Darrin goes to Merle's room, where the young warlock has turned a hairbrush into a model fire engine, which flashes with electric shocks when Darrin touches it. Darrin shouts with pain until Merle turns off the current. Samantha is now forced to disclose that Merle is a warlock. Merle again promises Samantha to refrain from magic in the house. That night a burglar who had seen Larry giving Darrin the necklace breaks in and overpowers Darrin. Darrin calls on Merle for a magical assist, but Merle stands by his promise. When the burglar finds the necklace, Darrin cons him into taking the fire engine too. As he reaches for it, Merle turns on his magic. Later, Gladys is more bewildered than ever as she hears the burglar explaining to the police how he was captured by a toy fire engine.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)

Darrin pleads with Samantha to let him fight, his own battles. Then, Joe and his Manager, trying to regain a crack at a lucrative championship bout, approach Darrin with a plan for a make-believe bout in which Joe pretends to knock Darrin out. Again, Darrin with the uncalled-on help of Samantha K.O.'s Joe. Finally, Darrin runs into Tommy Carter, the champ-himself. An unplanned for scuffle takes place. Tommy trips and knocks himself out. Later, Larry Tate tells Darrin he has solved the problem by hiring Tommy. Tommy's first assignment is to fight a four-round bout for charity. Darrin quakes at learning that Tommy is to choose his opponent. However, he sadly concludes that with Samantha insisting on being his second, he can't help winning again.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized)

An important client, Randolph Turgeon, insists on seeing Larry Tate, who is in Chicago. Wishing he were Larry for just one day, Darrin immediately turns into his boss. Turgeon introduces Darrin-Larry to his niece, Joyce, who wants a job with the agency. Louise Tate, who thinks her husband is with another woman, slaps her face, and makes him come home. Darrin phones Samantha for help. She arrives immediately, but is un-able to remove the spell. Just as Samantha is telling Darrin--Larry the spell will be over in fifteen minutes, Larry himself walks in. Hoping to keep the confusion from getting worse, Samantha puts Louise to sleep, and tells Larry his wife has been sleep-walking. Safe at home, Samantha tells Darrin Louise will feel she dreamed the whole episode. She asks Darrin what his first two wishes were. He mentions the elevator but decides to forget the girl in the bikini.

programme.desc: Tiffany is a beautiful 23-year-old who says that using drugs makes her feel complete, but that in reality, she knows she's just a lost little girl and a liar. After dropping out of three rehab programs for an OxyContin addiction, she says she wants to come clean with her parents and get clean from her substance abuse once and for all. But what is she keeping from her parents?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: More and more newlyweds are declaring their honeymoon is over and they're ready to call it quits. One wife feels she's not the only woman in her relationship. And, Dr. Phil follows up with Shamika and Marlon to see if they are getting their marriage back on track.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Imagine finding your son passed out in his room with drug paraphernalia surrounding his body. When that happened to one mother, she made an important call for help. Dr. Phil’s son, Jay, was working with a family for his new reality show when the mom, Vikki, phoned to say that her son, Justin, had been using drugs. Dr. Phil made a surprise house call and insisted that the teen get help immediately. Find out what happens with Justin, and why Vikki thinks she's to blame for his drug use. Then, a stay-at-home mother of three was drinking bottles of wine and vodka every day -- she would even fill a sports drink bottle with alcohol and take it to her kids' school events. Did she break her deadly addiction?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Think you’re ready to say, “I do?”… not so fast! Dr. Phil puts 3 newly engaged couples to the test in his Premarital Boot Camp series, with real-life challenges like parenting, fighting, money, and sex. Find out what happens when one couple leaves their “baby” unattended six times and why another couple has to do some major explaining to the California Highway Patrol. Will they all make it to the altar… and who will win big prizes?

programme.title: Dr.Phil
programme.desc: Sarah and Tecoa's mother, Cindy, sits down with Dr. Phil to answer some hard questions about how her daughters' lives have spun so out of control. Dr. Phil shows her some of the video footage of Sarah's life on the street, selling her body, smoking crack cocaine and shooting heroin, while Tecoa explains how it all began. In a race against time, Dr. Phil gets the sisters off the streets and into The Dr. Phil House. Will Sarah and Tecoa commit to rehab and stay clean?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A stay-at-home mother says she can't control her rage, and she takes it out on her kids. Dr. Phil intervenes for the sake of her five precious children.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Unemployed, unmotivated and under your roof - they're family freeloaders and they're hurting the ones they love the most. Dr. Phil has advice for a 28-year-old who still lives at home and a 20-year-old who is happy to live in his older sister's house but refuses to do any of the chores necessary to maintain it. Also, Dr. Phil finds out why a daughter thinks her mother is a gold digger.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The 1957 kidnapping and murder of Maria Ridulph went cold for 55 years, until Jack McCullough, once known as John Tessier, was arrested and eventually convicted -- despite maintaining his innocence. Dr. Phil speaks to family members on both sides. Could McCullough have been wrongfully convicted?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Jason and Brandy have been married less than a year, but they say the honeymoon is definitely over! His lying and flirting with other women has her addicted to snooping on him. Will they make it to their first anniversary or should they call it quits? Then, they've only been married for eight months, but Michael says his wife's violent temper is making his life a living hell. Dr. Phil shows them how to fight fair. Plus, a guest who's terrified of getting divorced … and he's not even married yet! Will he ever be ready to pop the question to his girlfriend?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Desperate for help with their drug-addicted 21-year-old son, Doug and Debbie ask Dr. Phil to prepare them for an intervention.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When it comes to families, conflict is nearly inevitable, but when you add the stress of a mental illness, it can divide even the closest knit household. Coni’s 18-year-old daughter, Katherine, was diagnosed with bipolar disorder at 12. Since then, her daughter’s behavior has been violent and erratic, and Coni says the chaos is tearing their family apart. Coni’s husband has threatened divorce, her oldest son has moved out, and her youngest daughter says her childhood was awful because of her older sister. The family thinks Katherine should be moved to a facility that can better serve her, but Coni says that is not an option. Learn what Dr. Phil says this family is doing wrong and how they can create a happy, peaceful household.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Did you know that close to 14 million adults still live at home with their parents? Dr. Phil’s first guest is 30 years old, has 2 kids, and is still living with her mom! Her mom wants her out, so why won’t she leave? Then, meet one mother who made her son sign a contract to move out for good. The deadline has lapsed, but he won’t budge. How far will Dr. Phil go to push him out of the nest? Plus, meet a couple who opened their home to 21 family members over the last 7 years. Finally, their nephew came to stay for a couple of days…and two years later he’s still there!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Does love really conquer all? James, 41, quit his job and left his wife and three children to pursue a relationship with his 18-year-old former student, Jordan. The couple says they're not breaking any laws, want to set the record straight with Dr. Phil, and want Jordan's mother, Tammie, to stop her Facebook "smear campaign" against them. In a national exclusive, Tammie confronts James for the first time on Dr. Phil’s stage. Find out how the attraction began and why Tammie says James is lying. Were there secret meetings before Jordan turned 18? And, what does Jordan stand to lose? Parents, how would you react if your child started a relationship with his or her former teacher?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Gypsy Willis- the former mistress of a doctor convicted of murdering his wife- speaks out.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: At 22, Jael was an aspiring model and finalist on the hit show America’s Next Top Model. But at 28, Jael’s family says she’s losing her battle with drug addiction. Don’t miss what happens minutes before she’s to appear on Dr. Phil’s stage. Can Dr. Phil convince her to stop running and commit to getting well?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Laurie says her dad, John, is in “total denial” about being an absolutely terrible hoarder. She says every room in the house is piled to the ceiling with “junk,” including the garage, where she claims she once found a “mummified kitten!” To top it off, Laurie claims the downstairs has a horrible bed bug infestation! John says his daughter is just as big of a mess as he is, has destroyed her room, and absolutely refuses to help him clear out the mess. But the junk-filled house is only the surface level of the toxicity in this home. Laurie’s ex-fiancé, Billy, also lives in the house! Laurie claims Billy is constantly getting “blackout drunk” and getting in fights with her and her father. Can Dr. Phil get to the root of the dysfunction in this home and start to clean up this mess? Find out!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In a headline-grabbing case, 22-year-old Sheena Morris was found hanged in a Florida hotel room on New Year's Day 2009, just hours after reports of an altercation between Sheena and her fiancé, Joe, now 48. Her death was ruled a suicide, but Sheena's parents refuse to believe that their daughter would take her own life -- they feel she was murdered, and that Joe may be responsible. In an effort to clear his name, Joe comes face to face with Sheena's mother and father, Kelly and David, on Dr. Phil's stage. What does Joe say happened on the night Sheena was last seen alive? And, how does his story differ from the one Kelly and David say they've pieced together? Listen to 911 calls from that night, including one from Sheena herself. Tune in and decide for yourself: Is there more to this story than Joe is revealing?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: There comes a point when every child must grow up and face life on their own. For today’s guests, that time has come and gone and they want stay with Mom and Dad! You’ll meet Ryan, whose father says he’s borrowed over $10,000, and has trouble standing on his own two feet. And watch as Dr. Phil gives another young adult the tools she needs to create a life of her own. Find out what needs to happen before your offspring fly the coop.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: For many girls, a fairytale wedding day is a sweet fantasy -- but getting the proposal can be a real nightmare! Amber and Rich are struggling through commitment issues. They live, work and have children together, and say they're happy but can't seem to take the next step. Rich sold Amber on his plan to marry her after five years, so why hasn't he proposed after nearly seven? Does he have valid reasons for resisting marriage? After Dr. Phil challenges him, will Rich decide to walk down the aisle ... on Dr. Phil's stage? Next, Jill has taken the leap and been divorced seven times. Why does she pick the wrong men, and what can she do to make her next union last? Then, Candy describes her first marriage as lasting 18 miserable years, and she regrets how she poisoned her daughters against men during that time. What will it take to change her daughter, who calls herself the Runaway Bride? Plus, a don't-miss moment happens in Dr. Phil's audience!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Have you ever been so devastated after a breakup that you wanted someone to literally pay for your broken heart? Or, have you ever wanted to exact revenge on someone who you believe stole a lover away from you? Dr. Phil's guests are broken-hearted lovers entangled in nasty lawsuits.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A woman who vanished reveals a dark secret.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What happens when an unhealthy teen relationship threatens to tear a mother and daughter apart? Giesel says her 18-year-old daughter, Devynn, is obsessed with her boyfriend and is damaging a once promising future. Watch the drama unfold as a pregnancy scare rocks this teen's life.

programme.title: Dr.Phil
programme.desc: The conversation continues with Heather, who says she is not at fault for her son's accidental overdose. But- where was she that night?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Mike and Vicki say their 37-year-old son, Ryan, was once making millions running a successful real estate company, but for the past three months, he has been living in their garage, on their dime, along with his 24-year-old girlfriend, Rachel. The parents claim Ryan is a “freeloader” who sleeps all day, acts entitled, picks fights and even leaves them to care for his 5-year-old son. Ryan admits things are chaotic in his life but insists it’s not all his fault. Why does he say his parents are partly to blame for his business failing? Dr. Phil has some tough questions for Ryan about his behavior -- does he take any accountability? And, hear from Rachel -- is she happy with their living situation? Plus, Ryan isn’t the only one staying with mom and dad -- you won’t believe how many mouths Mike and Vicki say they are feeding! How can the parents stop the bleeding and take back control of their lives? And, is Ryan ready to step up to the plate and work toward living on his own?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: As the nation reels from the intense pressure of the 2020 Election, Dr. Phil welcomes broadcaster, journalist, and author Piers Morgan, whose latest book, Wake Up, is all about our divided society in the wake of COVID-19, the BLM protests, and the controversy surrounding the presidential election. Watch while Morgan reveals details of a 25-minute phone conversation he had with Donald Trump -- their first communication in months after he unfollowed Morgan on Twitter earlier this year. Dr. Phil and Morgan take a look at some of the most shocking stories of celebrities who have been "cancelled" in 2020, as well as some of the most tone-deaf mistakes made by the rich and famous. Also, how does Morgan keep his emotional and mental health in check during these trying times? Tune in to find out!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: They borrow money and don't pay you back. They're unemployed and never pay rent. If you're tired of a loved one's freeloading ways, Dr. Phil has advice for getting the handouts to stop. Ryan, 29, says he's living the life of "a starving artist," but his sisters say he's just a moocher. He even tries to mooch off Dr. Phil! Then, Jennell says her husband has turned her into a moocher by forcing her to ask her own mother to pay their bills. Will he give up his dreams of playing poker professionally or keep gambling by living off their savings and watching his marriage slip away?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Money is often cited as the number one reason couples divorce. Dr. Phil talks with moms who say their money issues are causing major problems. Plus, the biggest mistakes people make when they think they have the latest, greatest money-making schemes.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Sheryl says it was love at first sight when she met her optometrist fiancé, Owen, in 2010 -- but the real eye opener came two years later, when she moved from Florida to New York to live with him and his three children. She claims that Owen, who makes six figures, refused to give her any spending money and treated her like the nanny and housekeeper -- all while she slept on a futon in the living room. Frustrated, she moved back to Florida a year later and called off the wedding -- so, why is she still wearing her engagement ring? Owen says Sheryl expects him to pay for everything, his friends and family disapprovingly call her a “gold digger” -- but he still wants to marry her! Dr. Phil offers the couple advice for moving forward. Should they proceed to the altar -- or alter their plans?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A possession is something we own, like a house, a car, or a new pair of shoes. But what happens when someone you know and love considers you their possession?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil digs further into the heartbreaking story of a father's desperate search for his missing daughter, Kimberly Medina, and the loss he felt when his grandchildren were taken away by the man who may be guilty of their mother's disappearance. It's a shocking story that has had a ripple effect on three generations. Don't miss this chilling tale that will have you hugging your loved ones a little tighter.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Toni says her daughter, Kristine, is battling an alcohol addiction and has resorted to drinking hand sanitizer as a cheap way to get her fix. Kristine says her family is dysfunctional, and they’re the reason she can’t stay sober. Dr. Phil has words of warning for Kristine. After three failed stints in rehab, will she agree to try again -- or risk losing her daughter forever?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A woman faces accessory charges after her fiancé's arrest for two murders.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Nina says even after she lowered her 15-year-old daughter, Nicolette’s, monthly allowance from $5,000 to $1,000, Nicolette is still overspending on her credit cards in order to keep up with teens in their hometown of Beverly Hills. Nina says she recently allowed a family friend, Joel, to move into her home so he could help chauffeur Nicolette around and watch her spending. Nicolette admits to spending her day having lunch in Beverly Hills, shopping, and making YouTube videos. Nina and Joel say they worry about Nicolette, who admits to having zero future goals except to not work, be rich, wear designer clothes and drive a Mercedes G-Wagen. Dr. Phil surprises Nicolette, her mother, and Joel by sending Nicolette on a special assignment near Skid Row in downtown Los Angeles a few days prior to taping Dr. Phil.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: More than 170,000 U.S. troops are stationed in Iraq and Afghanistan, sacrificing life and limb to keep America safe. Nearly 40,000 have been wounded, an estimated 300,000 are living with Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), and in 2005, there were at least 6,256 suicides among those serving in the armed forces. Many vets say when they return home, they feel mistreated and neglected and are forced to fight a medical system bureaucracy that doesn't hear them. Are we doing enough to care for our heroes? Find out what's really going on as Dr. Phil tackles this hot-button issue!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Imagine discovering that your next-door neighbor owns over 200 cats. Ray and Dennis never thought their neighbor, Kristy, would let her pet collection get that big. Once friends, the three are now in a nasty and vindictive war because of the felines. Ray and Dennis say Kristy's property is one big, disgusting litter box, and they want Kristy to get rid of her cats. Kristy says she'll never part with her "cat sanctuary." Are Ray and Dennis playing dirty in order to run Kristy out of town? When is it too much, and where do you draw the line in the litter box? Then, Mike says his wife, Lori, keeps everything from used envelopes to empty food jars and medicine bottles, because she "might need it" in the future. He is ready to take desperate measures to put a stop to this. Lori says the thought of throwing her stuff out is her worst nightmare. Is Mike guilty of making nasty bribes to get his wife to change? What's really behind Lori's habit for hoarding?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: MONEY! It’s one of the leading causes of divorce in America. Join Dr. Phil as couples turn to him to help solve their marital money woes. He’s a “born entrepreneur” and risk-taker whose choices have resulted in over $30k in debt. Is this a case of financial mismanagement or do their troubles run much deeper? Plus, find out why one wife feels she deserves more than a $50/week allowance from her tight-fisted hubby. Listen as Dr. Phil uncovers the real reason why these troubled twosome’s balance sheets aren’t adding up.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When you’re a bride-to-be, planning your wedding can be an emotional time for you and your parents. But what happens when your family members are not exactly jumping for joy over your upcoming nuptials? From a mom who is worried her daughter is rushing into a marriage with a complete stranger to a bride who says her father is ruining her big day, Dr. Phil helps families figure out how to keep the happiest day in a young couple’s life from turning into a nightmare. And, are you sure you're preparing for a marriage and not just a wedding? Find out the questions you must ask yourself before walking down the aisle.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Melanie says her 19-year-old daughter's boyfriend, Michael, is a gay, drug abusing gangbanger. What would cause her to have such a negative opinion of him? And is there any truth to her allegations? Learn why Michael initially agrees to a drug test, and then refuses. Will he finally break down and take it? And why does Melanie’s daughter, Caylin, support him anyway, regardless of the outcome? Then, Lori says her 17-year-old daughter, Mackenzie, is obsessed with a boy who's already broken up with her four times. Find out why Dr. Phil has a stern message for this mom.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Send the kids out of the room because Dr. Phil is talking about sex! Was the passion off the charts when you first started dating your spouse, but now your bedroom is a dead zone? If so, it’s time to resuscitate your relationship! With the help of Rabbi Shmuley Boteach, host of TLC’s Shalom in the Home and author of the book, The Kosher Sutra: Eight Sacred Secrets for Reigniting Desire and Restoring Passion for Life, Dr. Phil speaks with couples who say they’ve lost their libidos and want to bring back the magic. First up are Joy and Mark who say they haven’t had sex in almost four years. In fact, Joy says the last great sex she had was in 1988! Find out why Mark is terrified to make love to his wife. And, Kim and Adam have been married only four months and say they fight more than they have sex. How can they enjoy the honeymoon phase if they go to bed mad at each other? Plus, don’t miss the top five reasons you should have sex!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Trying to blend two families can be like mixing oil and water. Dr. Phil sits down with couples struggling to merge their families and create happy, peaceful homes. Samantha and Rob are on the verge of divorce. She says Rob favors their 4-year-old son over her children from a previous marriage and is too hard on her kids when it comes to discipline. Rob feels his wife undermines him in their home. Can these two align and create a parenting plan that they both agree on? Then, with six kids between them, they may look like the Brady Bunch, but Pete and Maureen say their life is no sitcom. Pete says he and his wife can’t agree on how to raise each other’s kids, and every argument brings them closer to a divorce. And, meet a stepmom who says she can’t bond with her stepkids. Dr. Phil spells out the myths and facts of being a stepparent and the most successful way to fulfill that role. Plus, what is your parenting style?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Are we raising a generation of ungrateful children? Melissa’s sisters say her sons are the most spoiled boys in North America. They get everything they want – all they have to do is whine. Melissa says her kids just like toys, and she thinks her sisters may be jealous of her lifestyle. Next, Dori admits that her 13-year-old son, Parker, is spoiled. Parker says he won't take no for an answer, and even has a strategy for getting everything he wants. Find out what's behind Dori's need to spoil Parker. Then, Joan says her 14-year-old daughter, Jacquie, is a snob, and her need for trendy clothes is turning her into a materialistic monster. Plus, Lauren spends her entire paycheck shopping, but with no money in her checking account, she’s afraid she could be headed for trouble. Her mom, Diane, says she's not worried, it's just Lauren's way of relaxing.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Being a single mother is hard enough, but imagine juggling soccer practice, PTA meetings and homework ... all while trying to cover up a secret life. Susan is a single mom with two kids who works as a prostitute to pay the bills. She says she's never had a real job and is addicted to the money she makes as an escort. Can Susan ditch her dangerous job and turn her life around? Then, Stephanie is a single mother of four and has been hiding a secret for 12 years. She's addicted to painkillers and takes up to 60 times the recommended dosage just to make it through the day. Fearing for their lives and those of their children, the women turn to Dr. Phil.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The four couples continue with the last leg of the teamwork challenge. After purchasing food at the market, the teams return to The House to cook their meal. Team One again finishes first, while Team Two doesn't even try, complaining about the unfairness of the game. Steve accuses Team One of cheating, which angers Lacey, who hates sore losers. After Stephanie brings up Scott's questionable tactics in the Hitched or Ditched game, Scott apologizes for cheating.Since the women complain that their fiancés don't pay enough attention to them, Dr. Phil invites some good-looking gentlemen to the house to shower the women with attention. While each woman has a one-on-one talk with an attractive stranger, the men secretly watch. All the women except Lilly don't hold back, telling the complete strangers the good, the bad and the ugly about their relationships. While Scott, Steve and Kalin confront their fiancées about what they revealed to the stranger, Tim and Lilly feel out of place, thinking their problems are minute compared to the others'. Dr. Phil has another meeting with the couples, and again asks them to stand up if they think they should get married. This time, only Tim, Lilly and Stephanie stand. Dr. Phil confronts Kalin about his anger and Lacey about her willingness to stay in an abusive relationship. Kalin admits that he needs help and says he doesn't want to be a monster. Dr. Phil tells Steve that if he marries Stephanie, she will make him miserable for the rest of his life. Stephanie agrees, and Dr. Phil points out that Steve just might be a nice guy who happens to love her. Will she stop trying to control him? Then, Scott asks Dr. Phil about how to deal with anxiety and depression, and Dr. Phil offers to help him obtain a proper evaluation and diagnosis. A grateful Scott and Lisa cry and hug each other. And, although Lilly and Tim think they don't fit in with the other members of the house, Dr. Phil assures them that they have a lot of work to do as well to be ready for marriage. He asks all the couples to think about whether they have realistic expectations, and tells them that they are all guilty of contaminating their relationships.Since money is the leading cause of divorce, Dr. Phil sets the couples up with money expert Marilyn Logan, who quizzes them about how well they know their partner's financial situation. The couples answer truthfully, but Lisa again embarrasses Scott by laying out all his financial missteps in sarcastic detail. At the end, Marilyn deems Tim and Lilly the winners of $20,000 from LowerMyBills.com. Go inside The House.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: They beg, borrow, and expect others to pay their way… they’re moochers! First up, Connie wants her freeloading, pot-smoking son to get a life. Then, newlywed Hillary is already sick of supporting her rock star wannabe husband. She wants him to get off the couch and start earning his keep. And what if your own mother was mooching off of you? Dr. Phil thinks it’s time these moochers get a wake-up call!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A woman who vanished finally faces her family.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Imagine meeting the man of your dreams. He’s your Prince Charming and completely sweeps you off your feet. But there’s a small problem; you’ve only known him three weeks -- and you’re already married! Dr. Phil speaks with Stephanie, who’s in the middle of a complicated love triangle with her husband, Robert, and the man she claims to love, Richard. Robert is desperate to save his marriage, even though this isn’t his wife’s first affair. Stephanie admits she has a constant need for male attention that may have stemmed from her childhood. What is at the root of her philandering ways? And, hear why Richard believes he’s done nothing wrong. Is Stephanie being totally honest to her current love interest, or is he doomed to fail with her as well?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Three families with one thing in common: they say their daughters, collegiate student-athletes, were suffering in silence before they died by suicide. They say their daughters faced immense pressure to balance it all, something that many student-athletes face, but often don’t express due to the stigma around mental health. All three families are pushing for change and more conversations about mental health on campus. Then, Thomas, a current student-athlete, shares his story of struggling with mental health as a D1 football player. He attempted to take his life but now shares his story as a message to others who may also be suffering alone.

programme.title: Dr.Phil
programme.desc: One of the most asked-about guests, Brandon, returns with an update.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Is there someone in your life you just can’t stand? Wouldn’t life be easier if you could find a way to make peace? Dr. Phil speaks with people who often struggle to get along: the ex-wife and the stepmom. Jennifer and her ex-husband’s new wife, Carol, hated each other for two years, until one pivotal moment changed their relationship forever. Together, they wrote the book No One’s the Bitch, and offer the 10 steps to strengthening the stepfamily -- starting with the women. Then, Lori says she's had a tense and rocky relationship with her husband’s ex-wife, Stephanie, and says the past eight years have been difficult. Can Dr. Phil get these two women to negotiate a new relationship? Just what are the boundaries for a stepmother? There are 1,300 stepfamilies forming every day in the U.S. Learn what you can do to ensure a happy and healthy family.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Imagine your weight getting so out of control that it confined you to your home, to a room, even to a bed. Dr. Phil's guests say they feel trapped and isolated in their homes and miss their loved ones.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil tackles one of the most dangerous trends affecting young adults today -- cyberbullying. Kalista, 20, claims she has been virtually assaulted for almost two years by Taylor, 20, a girl who Kalista says loves to attack people when they’re at their lowest point. Kalista says Taylor has posted photos of her online and written lies that she does drugs, is a stripper and a prostitute. Kalista says she’s not the only victim of Taylor’s alleged bullying -- Shelby, 22, and Shayna, 21, say they also have been targeted -- and she’s worried someone may be pushed too far. How do they say Taylor’s alleged actions have affected them? Taylor admits she has made nasty comments -- why does she say she was only defending herself? Dr. Phil brings all parties together to try to end the hostility. Are these young women ready to unplug and end the animosity? Plus, hear from the mother of a 12-year-old girl who tragically ended her own life after being cyberbullied. Will her story make an impact?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: It’s been three years since Glenn Lemoine’s body was found floating in a canal, and his death remains a mystery. His family wants answers -- and they’re pointing the finger at each other. Two agree to take polygraph tests -- what will the results reveal?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When 24-year-old Andee last met with Dr. Phil, she was struggling with drug addiction -- and her parents, Pam and Ed, blamed each other. After the taping, Andee says she completed 90 days of rehab but later relapsed and is now worse than ever. Is she finally ready to commit to staying clean?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In this powerful program, Dr. Phil exposes the frightening yet underreported problem of mothers on the verge on committing child abuse. We meet ordinary women who live in fear that they’re going to hurt their children in a fit of uncontrollable rage. Chrystel says she feels rage and snaps and then it gets to the point where there's no return. Jessica says her fits of rage become so intense, she's scared that she will hurt her son. Answering their desperate pleas for help, Dr. Phil explains how to identify cues leading up to this precarious state, and tells moms what to do when they start to lose control.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: If you or someone you know is pregnant, then you won’t want to miss today’s show! This episode is the first in a new series on pregnancy. Dr. Phil shares what they don’t tell you to expect when you’re expecting. Parents-to-be, Morgan and Shannon both have Type A personalities. She’s obsessed about her weight. He’s a neat freak. How can they prepare for an unpredictable lifestyle as parents? Then, tag along as they visit a daddy boot camp and a pregnancy gym. Plus, does carrying low mean you’re having a boy? An expert will help you sort out the truth from the myths when it comes to pregnancy.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his series on how to survive inflation. Today, financial experts share money-saving and money-making tips to help you learn how to take control of your finances during inflation. Plus, find out the best ways to use money to make money, savings hacks, freebie secrets, and get advice on how to set up the next generation for financial success.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil delves into a tragic story that spanned several decades, shattered lives and left one person behind bars. Fourteen children were held captive by a man who called himself The Messiah … a man who was also their father. Jeanne says she was raised in this environment, which the authorities called cult-like, and that she and her siblings were starved, beaten and had no schooling. In a tear-jerking revelation, Jeanne tells Dr. Phil that she was forced to perform unthinkable sexual acts with her own father, beginning when she was just 5 years old and ending when she was 27. Jeanne may be a victim of horrible cruelty, but her sisters, Miriam and Sarah, say they can’t forgive her for the pain she caused them. Find out why these siblings are estranged, and why Sarah says she’s nervous just sitting next to Jeanne on Dr. Phil’s stage. It’s been 20 years since Jeanne’s father was arrested, but she and her family say the effects of abuse still linger. Can these siblings ever get closure on their horrific past?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Former high school dance teacher Anne, 35, made national headlines when it was revealed that her two children -- ages 3 and 2 -- were fathered by Bradman, a former student who is 14 years her junior. Bradman, now 21, is claiming that their physical relationship began when he was 15 and that Anne made the first move. Facing possible prison time on two felony charges, Anne turns to Dr. Phil to tell her side of the story. Why does she believe that she is the victim? And, why does she say she filed a protective order against Bradman? Then, Bradman takes the stage to tell his side of the story. Why does he say he didn't reveal the nature of their relationship sooner? And, why is he coming forward now? It's a don't miss Dr. Phil!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Obesity is a huge problem for adults in this country, but now it’s becoming an epidemic among children as young as 3 years old. Barbra says her 3-year-old daughter started gaining weight at six months old and now weighs 80 pounds. Barbra and her aunt, Dana, are baffled by what they believe is a medical mystery because they say the little girl doesn't overeat. Dr. Phil brings in two medical experts to get to the bottom of this issue. Is Barbra contributing to her child's weight gain? Then, Tammy says she can’t change her family's eating habits. She's obese, her 11-year-old is 175 pounds and her 9-year-old is 136 pounds. Her sister, Debbie, says the boys portion sizes are too big and the family is just lazy. Can Dr. Phil get Tammy to stick to a nutrition plan? You won’t believe the surprise he has for her! Plus, Jessica says her mom, Angie, is blind to the health issues of her 351-pound sister, Jaleisa, who is only 15. Angie says her mom never buys healthy food, and fears she has Munchausen’s syndrome. Angie says she can’t monitor Jaleisa’s eating habits all day. Can Angie turn this situation around and save her daughter’s life, or is it too late?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When you walk down the aisle and say "I do," you look forward to a life of wedded bliss. But what if your bride or groom turned into your worst nightmare? Trish and Matt say their wedding day two years ago was full of love, joy and hope, but just months into the marriage, Trish became full of rage. She lashes out at her husband up to 15 times a day, and their physical fights often occur in front of their two young children. What's really at the root of Trish's rage, and should this couple ever have gotten married? Then, Tracy says when her husband, Shawn, lost 350 pounds, she lost her sweet, humorous spouse, and their five kids lost their loving father. She says Shawn is now an angry man obsessed with his appearance. Why do they both say that if they had met today, they would never have married? And what must Shawn do to get this marriage back on track?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Elizabeth and her husband, Bob, claim that Elizabeth’s 20-year-old daughter, Ali, is a “spoiled brat,” who refuses to go to college or get a job, has trashed their house and also steals from them. Dr. Phil has some tough questions for Ali about her behavior -- and for the parents, who admit they’ve enabled their daughter. Can Ali learn to stand on her own two feet?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Twenty-three-year-old Robert, who tips the scales at nearly 800 pounds, earned national attention when he made a desperate plea for Dr. Phil’s help in a YouTube video that tallied more than a million views. With his call answered, see Robert make the arduous journey to Dr. Phil’s stage with the assistance of two medical vans and five EMTs. Dr. Phil and Robert take a closer look at how he put on the weight, and what he needs to do to take it off. Is he really ready to make a change? Will Robert grab onto the lifeline Dr. Phil throws his way? And, Robert’s mother, Nanette, shares her insight into her son’s weight struggles. Has she unintentionally been enabling her son's condition? What role will she play in his recovery? Then, you may remember self-admitted adult baby, Brett who stirred controversy after he and his then-girlfriend, Cat, first appeared on Dr. Phil. Are they still a couple? Then, Meet Bill, who says he’d like to adopt Brett and be his new “daddy.” Will Brett accept his offer?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Robin joins Dr. Phil to answer your questions ... including the ones asking her to give up the dirt on Dr. Phil! What's Dr. Phil really like at home? What lands him in the doghouse? How does Robin stay in shape?

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: Learn about life on a Tudor ship from objects found on the Mary Rose, while on HMS Victory discover the battle-winning tactics of Admiral Nelson.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: The Heinkel He 111 is one of the most recognised German aircraft of WW2. The broad winged design was a guinea pig for future bombers, with more variants than any other military aircraft of the time.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: We trace the astonishing story of designers turning away from metal and back to wood to create a twin-engine bomber that could outrun almost any aircraft in the sky, yet deliver a bomb load greater than an Avro Lancaster.

programme.title: The Sound And The Fury
programme.desc: On September 1, 1939, Germany’s invasion of Poland throws the world into war. No longer a European affair, the conflict spreads: in the Pacific, Japan—at war with China since 1937—accelerates its imperial ambitions.

programme.title: The Sound And The Fury
programme.desc: In the East, Hitler launches Operation Barbarossa and invades the Soviet Union, reaching the outskirts of Moscow. But winter and Soviet resistance break his momentum. The Red Army, boosted by relentless propaganda, put up a fierce fight.

programme.title: WWII Air Crash Detectives
programme.desc: A C-47 transport plane, with a crew of four, is ferrying 24 trainee P-47 fighter pilots from the Bruning Army Air Field in Nebraska to the South Dakotan Pierre Army Air Field for advanced training.

programme.title: WWII Air Crash Detectives
programme.desc: It is the 25th of August, 1942. A Short Sunderland Flying Boat slams into Eagle Rock, a remote hillside in the far north of Scotland, killing fourteen people on board. Miraculously, there is one survivor.

programme.title: Wwii: Witness To War
programme.desc: During the early months and years of the war, Britain and her allies were almost powerless to hit back at Germany. They were on the back foot, unable to take the war to where the Germans would feel it most – Germany.

programme.title: Wwii: Witness To War
programme.desc: The expansion of the Japanese empire had as its main aim the conquest of territories rich in natural resources. And so Japan cast its eyes towards South East Asia.

programme.title: WWII Battles In Colour
programme.desc: 1942. Nazi Germany's Blitzkrieg enters Egypt. Field Marshal Erwin Rommel, aka the Desert Fox, has his eyes set on Cairo, but first he must overcome General Bernard Montgomery, the British Eighth Army, and the area's punishing fighting conditions.

programme.title: WWII Battles In Colour
programme.desc: July 1943. For six months, the German advance has stalled, but Hitler is convinced that his new generation of Nazi tanks will help put the Reich back on the path to European domination. His target: the Soviet town of Kursk.
